title: Tiny, cute jack-o'-lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- stem -->
  <rect x='46' y='18' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#6ab04c'/>
  <rect x='40' y='14' width='14' height='7' rx='3' fill='#4e9a2f'/>
  <!-- pumpkin body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='36' ry='32' fill='#ff8c1a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='36' ry='32' fill='none' stroke='#ffb347' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- pumpkin ridges -->
  <path d='M30 30 Q26 58 30 86' fill='none' stroke='#e07000' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 30 Q74 58 70 86' fill='none' stroke='#e07000' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 26 Q50 58 50 90' fill='none' stroke='#e07000' stroke-width='2.5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <path d='M34 50 L44 48 L38 62 Z' fill='#3a1a00'/>
  <path d='M66 50 L56 48 L62 62 Z' fill='#3a1a00'/>
  <!-- eye glows -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='54' r='2.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M32 68 Q38 64 44 68 Q50 72 56 68 Q62 64 68 68 Q64 80 50 80 Q36 80 32 68 Z' fill='#3a1a00'/>
  <!-- teeth -->
  <rect x='40' y='66' width='5' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='55' y='66' width='5' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- mouth inner glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='8' ry='2.5' fill='#ffb347' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M47 63 L53 63 L50 58 Z' fill='#e07000'/>
  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='40' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#ffcc66' opacity='0.5' transform='rotate(-20 36 40)'/>
</svg>
